mapper.select: SELECT t.ISSUE_ID, t.SCRN_ID, t.REG_EMPNO, t.ERR_CNTT, t.FILE_NM, t.FILE_CTYPE, CASE WHEN t.FILE_DATA IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS HAS_IMAGE, t.STAT_CD, t.PRIR_CD, t.RSLV_CNTT, t.CREATED_AT, t.CREATED_BY, t.UPDATED_AT, t.UPDATED_BY, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DASH_ISSUE_CMT c WHERE c.ISSUE_ID = t.ISSUE_ID) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM DASH_ISSUE t WHERE t.ISSUE_ID = #{issueId}
SELECT FILE_DATA, FILE_CTYPE FROM DASH_ISSUE WHERE ISSUE_ID = #{issueId} AND FILE_DATA IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DASH_ISSUE (SCRN_ID, REG_EMPNO, ERR_CNTT, FILE_NM, FILE_CTYPE, FILE_DATA, STAT_CD, PRIR_CD, RSLV_CNTT, CREATED_BY) VALUES (#{screenId}, #{regEmpno}, #{errCntt}, #{fileNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileCtype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileData,jdbcType=BLOB}, #{statCd}, #{prirCd}, #{rslvCntt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE DASH_ISSUE SET ERR_CNTT = #{errCntt}, STAT_CD = #{statCd}, PRIR_CD = #{prirCd}, RSLV_CNTT = #{rslvCntt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{actor} WHERE ISSUE_ID = #{issueId}
mapper.select: SELECT CMT_ID, ISSUE_ID, REG_EMPNO, CMT_CNTT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY FROM DASH_ISSUE_CMT WHERE ISSUE_ID = #{issueId} ORDER BY CMT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DASH_ISSUE_CMT (ISSUE_ID, REG_EMPNO, CMT_CNTT, CREATED_BY) VALUES (#{issueId}, #{regEmpno}, #{cmtCntt}, #{actor})
